title: Crafting & Skill Experience
dek: Choose a trade, follow its Skill Experience progression, and find the gathering, crafting and construction rules.
body:
← Blessings of Fenumion

Fenumion’s homebrew crafting system develops practical professions through Skill Experience. Each trade has its own permitted work, rolls, resources and timing.

Skill Experience ranks

Trade progression
Skill LevelSkill Exp. Required
Apprentice1,000
Journeyman4,000
Expert10,000
Master20,000

Explore the seven trades

01HunterHarvest magical components from defeated creatures.Read the rules →02SmithRefine materials and recover resources from magic items.Read the rules →03CraftsmanCombine components and materials into magic items.Read the rules →04ScribeResearch and copy spells into a personal book and the community library.Read the rules →05BuilderConstruct houses, businesses, vehicles, roads and settlements.Read the rules →06ScoutGather wood, stone, metal, plants and relics.Read the rules →07Beast WhispererTame approved beasts for personal use or other characters.Read the rules →

From resources to finished work

Hunters harvest magical components; Scouts gather materials; Smiths can refine materials; Craftsmen combine the supplies into magic items. Builders use materials for construction. Scribes expand spell knowledge, while Beast Whisperers work with approved creatures.

Changing professions

Before Journeyman rank, the source allows relative freedom to change trades. From Journeyman onward, a switch drops Skill Experience to the minimum of the next rank down. See the original examples and conditions in Switching Trade Skills.

Crafting and blessings

Blessings provide boon paths and listed costs. This crafting reference governs trade ranks and trade work. A conversion between Skill Experience and blessing costs, or additional blessing modifiers to trade rolls, is not specified in the supplied crafting rules.

Read the Fenumion Skill Descriptions source document. The reference retains its mechanics and wording.
